verdict.rationale: Kick, a bookkeeping SaaS, documents its own MCP server. The docs include a quickstart, named connectors for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, connection details for custom MCP clients, and an available-tools page, and they state it works with any MCP-compatible assistant, with tools to query transactions, generate reports, create rules and execute bookkeeping changes under user approval. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP endpoint works as documented (no probe of the MCP server itself).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
